page.title: My profile
page.unavailable: We can't display your profile right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
page.noStorefront: Your profile isn't open for editing yet. Please come back later: nothing is asked of you for now.

alias.name: Profile {alias}
alias.explain: Brands see you as {alias} until an introduction is opened.
alias.reveal: Your handle, your links and your exact figures are only shared with them at that point, and with them alone.
alias.forLife: Your alias is assigned for life: neither you nor INFLUX can change it.
alias.none: Your alias will be assigned when your profile opens.

layer.revealed: Visible only after an introduction is opened.
layer.internal: Visible only to you and the INFLUX team.

blocks.allSet: All the information asked for is filled in.

required.headline: short title
required.profileUrl: profile link on the main network
required.followers: follower count on the main network
required.mainAudienceShare: share of that country in your audience

field.limitReached: Limit reached: untick a choice to pick another.

headline.label: Short title
headline.help: Your activity in one line, 20 to 120 characters. No handle, no @, no link, no brand name.

bio.label: Bio
bio.help: 150 to 800 characters. Every registered brand reads it: no handle, no link, no contact details.

collaborationExperience.label: Experience of brand collaborations
collaborationExperience.help: A range is enough: don't name any brand.

contactEmail.label: Contact e-mail
contactEmail.help: Optional: your sign-in address is used otherwise.

city.label: City of residence
city.help: It is never shared with brands.

formats.label: Formats offered
formats.help: Tick the formats you offer, network by network.

usageIncluded.label: Usage rights included
usageIncluded.help: The rights you grant from the start. No box ticked: no right is granted from the start.

usageOptional.label: Usage rights as an option
usageOptional.help: The rights you can grant on top, to discuss with your sales contact. A right is in one of the two lists only.

maxExclusivity.label: Sector exclusivity accepted
maxExclusivity.help: The longest period during which you agree not to work with a competing brand.

acceptsNonMonetary.label: Non-monetary counterpart accepted
acceptsNonMonetary.help: Products, services or invitations in exchange for content. It does not replace the discussion with your sales contact.

availability.label: Availability
availability.help: It is always shown with the date it was declared.

refusedSectors.label: Sectors you refuse
refusedSectors.help: No brand and no message is told of it, and nothing is counted: this choice stays between you and the INFLUX team.

figures.confirmAll: To update the date of your figures, please also confirm how often you post and your average comments.
figures.stale: Your figures date from {date}. After 90 days, your profile is shown lower in results.

issues.unknown: This choice is no longer available: please pick another.
issues.duplicate: This value already exists: please remove the duplicate.
issues.wrong_network: This link doesn't match the chosen network.
issues.sum_exceeds_100: The total is over 100%. Please lower one of the shares.
issues.count: Enter a whole number, zero or more.
issues.percentage: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100, with two decimals at most.
issues.url_shape: The link must start with https:// and contain no space or credentials.
issues.share: Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100.
issues.share_min: Another country weighs 10 % of your audience at least.

errors.identifierInText: Your text contains what looks like a handle, a link or an identifier. Please remove it: it will be shared once the introduction is opened.

save.retry: Changes not saved — trying again in 5 s.

networks.unavailable: We cannot show your networks right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
networks.intro: One line per network. Your handle, links and exact figures are only shared once an introduction is opened; until then brands see bands only.
networks.empty: No network yet. Start with your main network: that is where your followers are counted.
networks.failed: This action did not go through. Please try again in a moment.

add.label: Add a network
add.help: One line per account: two accounts on the same network are fine, never the same handle twice.

primary.label: Main account
primary.help: Only one account is the main one: it is the first brands read.
primary.moved: {to} is now your main account; {from} no longer is.

bands.title: What brands see before any introduction
bands.none: No band yet: enter your followers and your other figures.

handle.label: Handle on the network
handle.help: Your public identifier on this network.

profileUrl.label: Link to your profile
profileUrl.help: It starts with https:// and leads to the chosen network.

pseudonym.label: Pseudonym
pseudonym.help: Your stage name, if it differs from your handle.

followers.label: Followers
followers.help: How many followers this account has today.

reach.label: Average reach per post
reach.help: The average number of people reached by a post.

engagement.label: Engagement rate (%)
engagement.help: Between 0 and 100, up to two decimals.

priorityMetrics.explain: These three figures are the first ones brands read: your community size, how often you post and your average comments.

posts30d.hint: Count your posts from the last 30 days: posts, Reels, videos, Shorts. Do not count stories or live streams.

comments.hint: Average the comments on your last 12 posts, leaving out giveaways.

engagement.unverified: Your engagement rate is not shown to brands until INFLUX has verified it.

offer.negotiation: Costs are negotiated with your sales contact.
offer.availabilityDeclared: Declared on {date}. Update it when it changes.

audience.intro: These percentages describe your audience, not you. Before any introduction, brands only see bands; your exact percentages are shared with them afterwards. What is missing to reach 100 % shows as "others": INFLUX never fills it in for you.
audience.noLines: First add a network in the "Social networks" block: the audience is filled in network by network.

countries.mainShare: Share of your audience in this country (%)
countries.otherShare: Share of your audience in this other country (%)

band.18_24: Share of your audience aged 18 to 24 (%)
band.25_34: Share of your audience aged 25 to 34 (%)
band.35_44: Share of your audience aged 35 to 44 (%)
band.45_plus: Share of your audience aged 45 and over (%)

genders.legend: Women, men and others in your audience

share.other: Share of your audience: others or not declared (%)
